text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: DMI = WTIO − SETIO. Positive and negative monthly values indicate the sign of the Indian Ocean SST anomaly gradient.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: A single monthly DMI value does not establish a persistent IOD event. Recently published values may be revised.
